claim: For the Athena per-query data usage control of a workgroup, you specify the Data scanned limit as a value between 10 MB (minimum) and 7 EB (maximum).
question: Athena workgroups: what range can the per-query Data scanned limit take?

qualifiers.scope: Data scanned limit of the per-query control limit in an Athena workgroup (Execution controls tab)
qualifiers.condition: One per-query control limit per workgroup; the default action is to cancel a query that exceeds the limit and this cannot be changed.

evidence.quote: Specify a value between 10 MB (minimum) and 7 EB (maximum).
